purpose: Compare evidence and constraints for one explicit continuation and up to two exploratory crop sequences on the same location and horizon.

generation.null_policy: Unknown remains unknown; null and intentionally empty lists are distinct.
generation.continuation: History alone does not determine a future continuation. Existing requires explicit continuation dates/sequence or a confirmed, phase-anchored repetition.
generation.locked_prefix: Preserve crops already fixed for the scenario; future exclusions apply to mutable candidate slots. Baseline stays visible even if it conflicts with new crop preferences.
generation.candidate_1: Minimum number of changes from existing among distinct permitted sequences, then stable crop-ID order. This is a deterministic design choice, not an agronomic ranking.
generation.candidate_2: Prefer a different crop multiset from candidate_1, then use the same stable enumeration. If unavailable, use a genuinely different temporal sequence.
generation.insufficient: Return fewer than two candidates explicitly; do not clone a candidate or fabricate an existing rotation.
generation.environmental_constraints: Unknown environmental inputs do not silently exclude crops. Calendar/management findings are reported after generation; generation is not a suitability certificate.

calendar.date_format: ISO8601 date without time; no timezone conversion
calendar.origin: Sowing or transplanting event is day zero for an explicitly sourced elapsed-day duration.
calendar.harvest: origin_date + duration_days; harvest day still occupies the main field
calendar.preparation: A declared gap starts at release; next start must be at least release + gap. Null gap does not mean zero.
calendar.uncertain_duration: Keep earliest/latest harvest and release; never select midpoint silently. Environmental summaries of endpoint windows are alternatives, not universal bounds on signed P-ETo or temperature.
calendar.nursery: Sowing-based total duration already includes nursery. Distinguish nursery and main-field resources; overlap is allowed only when separation is explicit.
calendar.horizon_start: An explicitly locked ongoing crop may start before the horizon. Preserve biological dates and verify occupation overlaps the horizon; a crop already finished before the horizon is not an ongoing crop. Clip exposure to the intersection, not the biological calendar.
calendar.horizon_end: Retain crops that continue past the horizon, show that state and clip only the exposure window. Never shorten the crop or extend the comparison horizon.

environment.sum_rule: Publish each total only when every expected day is valid for that metric; report expected and valid-day counts.
environment.paired_difference: D = sum(P_t-ETo_t) on identical paired days; incomplete pairs make the window D null. Keep negative and positive values.
environment.whole_horizon_invariance: Same location/source, dates and time mode must produce identical whole-horizon P, ETo and D for every strategy, including unassigned days.
environment.crop_windows: Exposure differs only through explicit field-occupation dates; this does not measure crop water consumption or savings.

climatology.mapping: Map target month/day endpoints and year offsets to each reference anchor year. Keep target duration; skip invalid leap dates, different day counts and windows extending beyond reference coverage, with reasons.
climatology.aggregation: Compute each yearly window first, then arithmetic mean, median, p10 and p90; type7 linear quantiles. D distribution comes from yearly paired D values.
climatology.sample_count: Report complete years per metric and skipped years; percentiles unavailable with fewer than two complete windows. A full 365-day year has 22 analogues and a 366-day year has 8 under this strict mapping; the 1991-2020 source baseline remains 30 calendar years.
climatology.comparison_cohort: Separate distributions retain their anchor-year lists/counts and a cohort-difference note. Any numerical cross-window delta requires recomputation over the same paired anchor years complete for both metrics/windows; never subtract means from different cohorts or infer a causal crop benefit.
climatology.forecast_label: Never label an analogue as a seasonal forecast.

environment.vegetation: Strict-good MODIS only, assigned by selected pixel observation date; counts/gaps/mixed-pixel and spatial limits remain visible. No species, planting, harvest or fallow inference.
environment.soil: Use the containing extracted cell and stated depth. Quantiles describe source prediction uncertainty, not spatial variation over the farm. No averaging pH across depths.
environment.spatial_support: Explicit example/regional context or extracted containing support per layer. No silent nearest-point fallback or invented field resolution.

rules.output: Per-layer availability and source support; unavailable layers do not become zero.
Specific missing inputs, certain conflict, possible conflict, or no conflict in the supplied calendar. This is not agronomic suitability.
P, ETo, paired P-ETo, mean T2M, coverage and operational-guard count. Irrigation demand remains null.
Relationship to historical species optimum, plus uncertainty. An outside-optimum value never proves crop failure.
Context relative to species optimum only. Do not interpret Tmax above optimum as stress/failure days or yield loss.
Generic whole-season ET reference per crop. Do not scale, subtract annual rainfall, calculate local ET or rank water savings from overlapping ranges.

Rice direct seeding/transplanting does not establish a flooded-paddy or upland ecosystem. Unknown water regime needs input; known flooded-paddy to upland transition triggers management review. User-reported good drainage alone is not verified suitability.
Conditional fixation mechanism if soybean is included. Nitrogen credit and fertilizer savings remain null.
Needs local host evidence; a different crop name alone is not a demonstrated pest break.
Historical strict-good indices and counts as context; no inferred farm rotation or causal strategy benefit.
Historical categorical model reference, keeping management regimes separate. No continuous score or prediction of current field performance.
Deferred from MVP; no revenue/profit from suitability, satellite greenness or species labels.

priority_policy: Highlight checks relevant to the explicitly selected priorities. Do not fabricate weights or turn presentation order into a benefit ranking.
overall_status: Use invalid_input, partial, or complete_for_selected_checks. Always keep local_agronomic_validation=false until actual review; completed checks do not imply safe field advice.
